title: Buzz Web brand profile
description: Brand surface for one Buzz Web variant. Every path is relative to the repository root and must already exist there. scripts/brand/new-app.mjs rejects unknown, missing, or malformed fields before it writes anything.

id.description: Lowercase slug used for the branch, the worktree directory, and every generated asset filename.

displayName.description: Full product name, used verbatim in the page title, i18n copy, and the manifest name.

shortName.description: PWA manifest short_name; the value an operating system can show under a home-screen icon.

communityName.description: Public config communityName. Runtime config overrides it; it is also the fallback and the welcome heading.

description.description: Social and meta description. The page meta description is '<displayName> — <description.en>'. zh-CN is optional and is recorded for future localized metadata; it is not rendered today.

manifestDescription.description: PWA manifest description. Only en is written because the manifest has a single description field.

relayUrl.description: Public Relay WebSocket URL written to config.json.

ogImageUrl.description: Absolute social card URL, including the deployment base path, e.g. https://app.example.com/app/<id>-og.jpg.

themeColor.description: Browser theme color and PWA theme_color.

sans.description: Tailwind fontFamily.sans. Quote a multi-word family inside the string, e.g. '"Segoe UI"'. Files must be self-hosted; no remote font hosts.

ogImage.description: 1200x640 social card source; copied to web/public/<id>-og.<ext>.

logo.description: In-app logo source; copied over web/src/assets/app-icon@3x.png.

appIcon.description: Legacy public icon source; copied over web/public/app-icon.png.

assets.description: Source artwork in this repository. The script writes web/public/<id>-{favicon.ico,favicon-32.png,apple-touch-icon.png,icon-192.png,icon-512.png,og.<ext>} with sizes 32, 180, 192, 512 respected.

features.description: Public Relay feature toggles, matching RelayFeatureState in web/src/shared/features/relay-features.ts.

agents.description: Optional declared Relay agents written to config.json. Omit the key to publish an empty list.

flags.description: Product-specific switches the script does not implement, only records and warns about. Known: nusukAuth (Nusuk SSO wiring in web/src/shared/lib/nusuk-auth.ts).
